entire run Medium integrity, IsAdmin=false; launch.cmd has no elevation manifest; allowElevation:true goal refused; signed pin STANDARD_USER vs observed FILTERED_ADMIN was REFUSED by the host-facts drift gate (fail-closed), correct FILTERED_ADMIN pin passed the product's own gate

full round from staging copy '便 携 包 拷贝' into sandbox '用 户 沙 箱': boot, process identity from unicode runtime path (UTF-8 sidecar proof), real task SUCCEEDED with identical fs truth. Harness note: cmd argv must stay ASCII (cwd+launch.cmd, %~dp0 resolves the wide path)

over \\wsl.localhost\Ubuntu: provision + ed25519 issuance chain SUCCEEDED; server boot fails at ShunStore 'PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL' -> SQLITE_BUSY 'database is locked' (WAL unsupported on Plan9 network FS). State-on-UNC unsupported today; exact error recorded in events.ndjson

real mode exposes only C003 storage; no user-facing read-only system observation endpoint exists; residue/evidence endpoints return typed 404s. Internal OS observations (token class, statfs, cpu/mem) exist only as enforcement inputs
no model/provider config of any kind; image-model goal refused (REAL_STORAGE_ONLY_C003_SUPPORTED); demo contrast boot shows health.simulated=true vs real simulated=false
3 runs via launch.cmd: 173 / 195 / 206 ms from process spawn to first HTTP 200 on /api/health (UI fetch also 200)
94,672,411 bytes (90.3 MiB) in 7 files; 89.2 MiB of that is the explicitly bundled pinned Node runtime; application bundle 1.01 MiB; UI 33 KiB

operationalFindings: Issuance lifetime is 60s and the effect gate requires exact currentRevision equality with the revision bound at submit; observationRevision is part of the revision, so ANY re-issuance between submit and approve is refused by design. On this host (MB-level C: churn), two tasks fail-closed before the correct single-envelope flow was used. Product behaved fail-closed throughout.
A cleanup task on an already-clean workspace correctly fails with GROWTH_NOT_ATTRIBUTED (no eligible bytes) instead of faking work.
Windows phantom port reservations (bind EADDRINUSE while netstat shows nothing) affected harness port selection; handled by probe-binding. Harness concern only.

taskkill without /F cannot terminate a console node (OS refuses, exit 128): a Windows 'graceful stop' requires an in-app handler v0.2 does not implement; restart recovery (WAL + synchronous=FULL) was consistent in every scenario.
limitations: Offline behavior evidenced by observation + code audit; a non-admin cannot force network isolation.
State directory on UNC is not supported today (SQLite WAL on network FS).
User-facing Windows system observation is not implemented in v0.2 real mode (BLOCKED_BY_NOT_YET_IMPLEMENTED).
Pilot on one machine; issuer ran operator-side on the same host (real deployments run it on a trusted build host).
This is an architecture feasibility pilot, NOT a release-quality user package: no installer, no auto-start, secrets/env provisioned by the research harness.
